question: What is the daily intake amount that defines a macro mineral?
explanation: Macro minerals are the minerals the body needs in larger amounts every day, specifically anything greater than 100 milligrams. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h1)

question: Why do macro minerals need to work together in the body?

options.A: All macro minerals have the exact same chemical structure
options.B: Only one macro mineral can be absorbed by the intestines at a time
options.C: Minerals cancel each other out if consumed in the same meal
options.D: The proper function of one mineral often relies on the presence of others

explanation: Minerals like calcium and magnesium work closely together in the body, meaning a shortage of one can affect how well another works. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h1)

question: Where is most of the calcium in the human body stored?
explanation: About 99 percent of the body's calcium is kept in the skeleton and teeth to give them strength. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h2)

question: How does a pregnant mother's body protect her baby if her diet lacks enough calcium?

options.A: It manufactures new calcium inside the placenta
options.B: It releases calcium from the mother's own bones into the bloodstream
options.C: It absorbs extra calcium from the mother's skin
options.D: It halts foetal bone growth until the mother eats more dairy

explanation: When dietary intake is too low, the body draws on calcium stored in the mother's bones to make sure the baby still gets enough. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h2)

question: Which hormone increases during pregnancy to help the body absorb more calcium?
explanation: Calcitriol is the active form of vitamin D. It increases during pregnancy to help the intestines absorb more calcium. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h3)

question: During which stage of pregnancy does the transfer of calcium to the baby happen the fastest?
explanation: The baby's bones grow the fastest during the last three months of pregnancy, which is when calcium needs are highest. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h3)

question: Which local Nigerian food is a good source of calcium because it is eaten whole with its soft bones?
explanation: Eating small dried fish with their soft bones intact provides a very accessible source of dietary calcium. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h4)

question: Why might dark green leafy vegetables provide less usable calcium than dairy products?

options.A: Plant oxalates can reduce how much calcium the body absorbs
options.B: Cooking vegetables destroys all mineral content instantly
options.C: The body cannot digest plant cell walls at all

explanation: Natural compounds called oxalates in some greens bind to calcium, making it harder for the intestines to take it up. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h4)

question: What is a common early sign of low calcium levels during pregnancy?
explanation: Low calcium affects the nerves and muscles, often showing up as painful spasms or cramps in the legs and feet. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h5)

question: Which condition is NOT directly caused by long-term calcium loss in mothers?
explanation: Gestational diabetes is related to blood sugar and insulin, whereas calcium depletion directly affects bone density conditions like osteopenia and osteoporosis. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h5)

question: Why should calcium supplements be taken at a different time from iron tablets?

options.A: Iron destroys the chemical structure of calcium
options.B: Taking them together causes immediate vomiting
options.C: Calcium can block the proper absorption of iron in the gut
options.D: Combined tablets are too large to swallow safely

explanation: Calcium interferes with iron uptake in the digestive tract, so midwives advise spacing these two supplements a couple of hours apart. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h6)

question: A pregnant woman is prescribed calcium carbonate at an antenatal clinic in Lagos. What advice should the midwife give her about taking it?

options.A: Avoid eating anything for four hours after taking the pill
options.B: Swallow the tablet strictly on an empty stomach first thing in the morning
options.C: Take the supplement alongside a meal to improve absorption
options.D: Crush the tablet and mix it directly into cold palm oil

explanation: Calcium carbonate needs the stomach acid produced during digestion to break down properly and absorb into the bloodstream. [learn more](BMP118_U2_T6#BMP118_U2_T6_h6)
